alternate_titles: Declaration of 6 March 1964 on the theological qualification of conciliar teaching
work.author: Second Vatican Council Doctrinal Commission
work.description: The two-paragraph declaration of 6 March 1964 distinguishing matters the Council openly declares to be defined from its remaining teaching, which the faithful receive according to the Council's manifested mind and the norms of theological interpretation. The declaration was reproduced in the separately modeled Lumen gentium and Dei Verbum notifications.
